test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 28 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Hinayana and Mahayana are sects of which religion?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Buddhism.__**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• Buddhism is **one of the world's largest religions** and originated 2,500 years ago in India.
 
• Buddhists believe that human life is one of suffering and that meditation, spiritual and physical labour and good behaviour are the ways to achieve enlightenment, or nirvana.
 
• The biggest fundamental difference between **Mahayana and Hinayana **Buddhism is the **worship of gods and goddesses**.
 
• Mahayana **workshops the bodhisattvas**, while **Hinayana Buddhists think that Buddha was the human** instead of God because Hinayana thinks that Buddha was simply a man who found a way to Nirvana.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Jainism is **one of the world's oldest religions**, originating in India at least 2,500 years ago. The spiritual goal of Jainism is to become liberated from the endless cycle of rebirth and to achieve an all-knowing state called **moksha**
 
• **Sikhism is an Indian religion that originated in the Punjab region **of the Indian subcontinent, around the end of the** 15th century CE**. Sikhism advocates **equality, social justice, service to humanity, and tolerance for other religions**. 
 
• **Hinduism i**s variously defined as an Indian religion, a set of religious beliefs or practices, a religious tradition, a way of life, or dharma—a religious and universal order by which followers abide
